verdicts.quote: Decision D-1 ... automatic promotion, no timed claim window ... the first `Waiting` entry is turned into a `Confirmed` booking for that member
waitlist order is first-in-first-out by successful join; position = 1 + number of `Waiting` entries ahead. ... Left out: priority tiers/membership levels ... priority order other than join order
Left out: ... skipping an entry that conflicts in time with another booking ... OG-6 (time-overlap and per-member limits across classes: default A-2 allows any)
verdicts.missing: Whether promotion into one overlapping class removes or skips the member's entry on the other; the overlap conflict is left open.

verdicts.quote: Not seat-freeing: ... a no-show (no no-show concept requested). ... Left out: ... late-cancel penalties.
verdicts.missing: Whether an existing no-show/late-cancel policy applies to a promoted member who never learned of the automatic promotion.

verdicts.quote: Seat-freeing events ... (a) the member cancels their own booking ... promotion completes synchronously with the cancel response; the only async part is notification

one notification through the app's existing notification channel stating class and time and that they are now confirmed ... dispatch failure never rolls back or delays the promotion; it is retried ... logged with the promotion identifier
k seats freed at once promote the first k entries in order ... Two cancellations racing for the same class yield the same final state in either order (S-4) and never overbook (I-1).
a member is never both `Confirmed` and `Waitlisted` for the same class ... serialised per class: all changes to one class's confirmed set and waitlist apply in one order
verdicts.missing: What happens to a waitlisted member's entry and booking attempt when they book directly while being promoted; the race is not described.

verdicts.quote: if booking consumes credits, payments or a membership entitlement, how promotion handles insufficient entitlement. User decision. Default A-5: no entitlement step exists; if one does, R-3 is unready.
verdicts.missing: When payment is taken for a promoted booking and what happens if it fails.

verdicts.quote: Maximum waitlist length: unresolved bound, OG-3. If a cap C exists, a join at length C is rejected `WAITLIST_FULL` with no change
verdicts.missing: Whether a cap exists, its value, and whether it is per class.

verdicts.quote: at close time, or when the studio cancels the class, every `Waiting` entry becomes `Expired`, joins are refused, and no promotion occurs afterwards even if a seat frees.
(c) capacity is raised *if the existing app can* (OG-9).
verdicts.missing: Capacity lowering while a waitlist exists, and whether staff capacity changes exist and should promote (OG-9 open).

verdicts.quote: Class cancelled by the studio: confirmed members are handled by existing behaviour; waitlisted members are notified "class cancelled" (one message each) in addition to expiry.
The waitlist entry holds: member id, class id, join sequence, join time, status. ... Position is derived from the sequence at read time, not stored.
Kept: `Waiting` entries until promoted, left, or expired; terminal-entry retention matches the existing booking-record retention (period unresolved, OG-8).
the app shows no other member's identity, position or count of waitlisted people (the total length is not shown
no staff waitlist features are requested ... Left out: staff removing members from a waitlist (OG-9) ... staff views of waitlists: do they exist
verdicts.missing: Whether staff can view the waitlist, promote or remove by hand, and see a promotion history; left as an open gap.

verdicts.quote: Seat release and promotion are one indivisible outcome (I-2). ... promotion completes synchronously with the cancel response
booking an `Open` class, cancelling a booking, viewing bookings, authentication and class listings behave as before, except where R-1..R-7 explicitly change them
